verdict.rationale: Context.dev publishes a first-party API reference with per-endpoint pages (brand, styleguide, prefetch, people enrich, news search, batches, answers) and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so an explorable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive playground or try-it console, runnable or executable examples inside the reference, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Look up a brand by domain, name, email, ticker, transaction, or URL and return a company profile.
Research a question or task on the live web and return JSON with source URLs.
